name: WittyCD
summary: Audio CD images played as discs: gapless, with their tracks, indexes and CD-TEXT, in a CD player.
updates: All of the engine (reading images, playing them as one stream, its FLAC encoder), the CD player in the web app, and finding which album a disc is, on every app.
stays: Asking MusicBrainz and fetching covers, the stream's FFmpeg conversion and how a library shows a disc stay with the server: the process that reads an image never has a network.
